question_text: Has the company executed a compliant Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with every vendor storing, transmitting, or processing Protected Health Information (PHI)?
remediation_action: Audit all third-party vendor contracts and execute standard HIPAA BAAs immediately.

question_text: Do any physician compensation structures, joint ventures, or consulting agreements consider the volume or value of referrals under the federal Anti-Kickback Statute (AKS) or Stark Law?
remediation_action: Engage healthcare regulatory counsel to restructure agreements to standard Fair Market Value (FMV).

question_text: If operating in Corporate Practice of Medicine (CPOM) restricted states, is the clinical entity wholly owned by licensed physicians and managed via a compliant MSO agreement?
remediation_action: Establish a Management Services Organization (MSO) structure with independent physician-owned professional corporations (PCs).

question_text: Are all clinical and operational personnel screened monthly against federal OIG/SAM exclusion lists to ensure eligibility for federal healthcare programs?
remediation_action: Implement automated monthly screening against the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE).

question_text: Has the company obtained HITRUST CSF certification or completed an independent SOC 2 Type II audit covering the HIPAA Security Rule?
remediation_action: Initiate SOC 2 Type II audit readiness and close identified administrative and technical safeguards gaps.

question_text: Under which FDA risk category is your primary device classified (Class I, Class II, or Class III)?
remediation_action: Determine classification to trigger conditional regulatory diligence pathways.

question_text: Has the facility completed annual FDA Establishment Registration and Device Listing under 21 CFR Part 807?
remediation_action: Submit FDA Form 2891 for establishment registration and Form 2892 for medical device listing.

question_text: Has the device secured active FDA 510(k) clearance, and is substantial equivalence documentation for the predicate device archived?
remediation_action: Prepare 510(k) premarket notification or De Novo classification request.

question_text: Has the FDA granted Premarket Approval (PMA), and are human clinical trial results compliant with 21 CFR Part 812 (IDE) on file?
remediation_action: Suspend commercial distribution; complete pivotal clinical trials and submit PMA dossier.

question_text: Is the Quality Management System (QMS) aligned with the FDA Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR) and ISO 13485:2016?
remediation_action: Transition legacy QSR documentation to ISO 13485:2016 structure per FDA QMSR requirements.

question_text: For connected devices or Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), does documentation include a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and threat modeling per FDA cybersecurity guidelines?
remediation_action: Generate automated SBOMs and conduct third-party penetration testing on device firmware/software.

question_text: Does the company maintain documented Medical Device Reporting (MDR) standard operating procedures and adhere to Unique Device Identification (UDI) labeling?
remediation_action: Adopt compliant MDR adverse event reporting procedures and integrate UDI barcoding into packaging.

question_text: Are all critical component suppliers qualified through documented audits and governed by active Quality Agreements?
remediation_action: Execute formal Quality Agreements specifying mandatory notification for raw material or process changes.

question_text: What is the current FDA status of primary drug candidates (Pre-clinical, Active IND, Phase I, Phase II, Phase III, or Approved NDA)?
remediation_action: Map stage of development to clinical trial milestone budgets and pipeline timelines.

question_text: Are all preclinical and clinical studies conducted in strict compliance with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP - 21 CFR Part 58) and Good Clinical Practice (GCP)?
remediation_action: Audit contract research organizations (CROs) for GLP/GCP compliance; remediate study trial master files.

question_text: Do active manufacturing facilities and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) comply with current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP - 21 CFR Parts 210/211)?
remediation_action: Execute technical quality agreements and verify CDMO FDA Form 483 inspection history.

question_text: Are core molecule and formulation patent claims listed (or eligible to be listed) in the FDA Orange Book, and what is the earliest patent expiry date across the portfolio?
remediation_action: Perform patent landscaping to determine Hatch-Waxman exclusivity extensions and generic challenge exposure.

question_text: Do any pipeline compounds involve DEA controlled substances, and are all necessary DEA manufacturing, import/export, and handling registrations active?
remediation_action: Obtain or renew required DEA Schedule I-V registrations and establish quota tracking.

question_text: Was any underlying platform technology developed using government funding or university facilities subject to Bayh-Dole Act march-in rights?
remediation_action: Review institutional tech-transfer agreements to ensure compliance with federal reporting and US manufacturing requirements.

question_text: Has a comprehensive, third-party Freedom to Operate (FTO) analysis been completed for all cell lines, genetic sequences, and delivery vectors?
remediation_action: Commission formal FTO legal opinion for high-risk genetic constructs and licensing targets.

question_text: For biologic candidates, has the regulatory pathway for Biologics License Application (BLA - 21 CFR Part 601) and potential biosimilar competition been defined?
remediation_action: Formulate BLA regulatory dossier and establish 12-year reference product exclusivity strategy.

question_text: Are Master Cell Banks (MCB) and Working Cell Banks (WCB) fully characterized, identity-tested, and cryopreserved across geographically diverse backup repositories?
remediation_action: Establish dual-site redundant cryogenic storage contracts for all proprietary cell lines.

question_text: Has the clinical software functionality been evaluated against FDA Clinical Decision Support (CDS) guidance to confirm non-device status or SaMD classification?
remediation_action: Document regulatory rationale validating exemption under 21st Century Cures Act or initiate 510(k) preparation.

question_text: Does the platform adhere to ONC Health IT interoperability mandates, including HL7 FHIR release 4 APIs, for electronic health record (EHR) integrations?
remediation_action: Upgrade data ingestion pipelines to support standardized HL7/FHIR APIs and USCDI standards.

question_text: What is the trailing 12-month clean claims rate and first-pass payment rate for commercial and government health insurance claims?
remediation_action: Implement pre-submission claim scrubbers to decrease medical billing rejection and denial rates.

question_text: Does the system store data in multi-tenant cloud environments with end-to-end encryption (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit) and role-based access controls (RBAC)?
remediation_action: Enforce database field-level encryption and configure centralized RBAC with mandatory multi-factor authentication.
